title: Super CUP ATTP – Summer 2025 ELITE Stage: a major table tennis event makes history in Chișinău
excerpt: Super CUP ATTP – Summer 2025 ELITE Stage
body_html:
The curtain has come down on one of the most intense and spectacular stages of the Super CUP ATTP table tennis cycle, the summer 2025 session. The final ELITE Stage brought the elite of table tennis to TOP CUP Academy in Chișinău, turning the arena into a hotbed of adrenaline, passion and textbook technique.

At the table, every point was a battle and every rally a display of total determination. Established favourites and unexpected revelations brought the hall to its feet, giving the public not just matches but real stories of struggle and sporting glory.

🏆 The champion of the summer 2025 season is master Denis ȚERNA, who dominated the competition with perfectly calibrated play and iron concentration. His classic style, lightning top-spins and calm in the decisive moments made him the new holder of the ATTP Super Cup.

🥈 Veniamin DUBROVIN took second place on the podium after a high-intensity final in which every rally was a display of endurance and tactical intelligence.

🥉 Igor NI and Danila TITOV completed the honours board, showing through their play that elite performance is the hallmark of this tournament.

🔹 And yet one of the biggest revelations of this edition came from young master Demik YING — a huge surprise for the spectators and a formidable opponent for any established player. With spectacular play, flawless strategy and courage worthy of the big stage, Demik overturned the predictions and won everyone’s respect. His performance was a lesson in ambition and pure talent, leaving the impression that the future of Moldovan table tennis already has a new name to watch.

More than a competition, Super CUP ATTP – Summer 2025 was a statement of strength: table tennis in the Republic of Moldova is growing, lives through its players and writes its own legend with every edition.
